details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime and then executes a heavily-obfuscated 727KB payload (math_init.js) at install time. The payload is obfuscated with a javascript-obfuscator string-array decoder and thousands of _0x identifiers, hiding its runtime behaviour. The package also depends on the known-malicious packages @or-sdk/flows, @or-sdk/step-templates, and @or-sdk/store, which are pulled in during installation. Installing this package runs the obfuscated payload on the victim's machine via the downloaded runtime.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
